gloss: to be skilled at; to excel in

definitions.gloss: to be skilled at; to excel in
definitions.explanation: To have a high level of ability or expertise in a particular field or skill. Almost always used in the form に長けている to describe someone's proficiency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けた⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a writer skilled in the use of language.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧IT⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けた⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{集|あつ}まっている→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: That company has gathered many people who excel in IT.

notes:
Almost exclusively used in the pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧. Rarely seen in other conjugated forms. Describes a developed, practical competence rather than innate talent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (to be skilled at ~)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けた + noun (skilled at ~ [modifier])

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (skilled at negotiation)
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (skilled in technology)
- ⟦{弁舌|べんぜつ}→弁舌：27671_benzetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長|た}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (skilled in speech/rhetoric)
